value.rationale: The 2023 comparison between open and closed random-walk support motivates determining the exact direction of expectation bias. The theorem classifies all graph orders and times without exceptional unverified parameters, identifies a unique triangle/odd-time reversal contrary to the usual contraction intuition, and shows that even when the expectation is smaller the odd-time range laws can remain stochastically incomparable. This natural global finite classification is not a chosen arbitrary numerical slice or a restatement of general existing bounds.
